item.title: After-school program in Boston, GA at capacity & pushing to expand
item.description: A Boston tutoring program is raising $75,000 to expand. Organizers say the money will help them serve high schoolers and students with disabilities after outgrowing their current space.

item.title: Lawmakers push back after judge clears the way for changes to the Florida's AIDS Drug Assistance Program
item.description: A Florida judge has cleared the way for changes to the state's AIDS Drug Assistance Program. Advocates say more than 16,000 residents could lose access to life-saving medication as soon as March 1.

item.title: Valdosta receives $2 million grant to upgrade stormwater infrastructure after Hurricane Helene
item.description: The money comes from the Georgia Department of Community Affairs, and it will help areas in Valdosta impacted by Hurricane Helene. Construction is set to begin summer 2026.
